meta.title: An array level
meta.subtitle: eatws runs between any two states

states.label: start
states.explanation: json_tokener_state_start looks at the first byte of a value: '{' opens an object, '[' an array, and anything else starts a string, number or literal on this same level.

states.label: array / array_after_sep
states.explanation: One case handles both: ']' closes the array (rejected after a comma in STRICT mode); any other byte checks the depth limit and pushes a child level for the next element.

states.label: array_add
states.explanation: Appends the value the child level handed back in obj to the array in current.

states.label: array_sep
states.explanation: ',' goes back to array_after_sep for the next element; ']' finishes the array.

states.label: finish
states.explanation: At depth 0 the call jumps to out:. Deeper, it takes a reference to current into the local obj, resets this level, decrements depth and re-checks the same byte in the parent's state (array_add or object_value_add).

states.label: goto out
states.explanation: Every state sets tok->err and jumps to out: on a byte it cannot accept.
